name: softicon-related-posts
description: Related posts by category, tag or any taxonomy, with a Gutenberg block

scripts.i18n: npm run i18n-pot && npm run i18n-json && npm run i18n-mo
scripts.zip:
rm -f softicon-related-posts.zip && printf '→ Building block
' && (npm run -s build >/dev/null 2>&1 || npm run build) && printf '→ Translations
' && (npm run -s i18n >/dev/null 2>&1 || npm run i18n) && npm run -s find-ds && printf '→ Zipping
' && cd .. && zip -rq softicon-related-posts/softicon-related-posts.zip softicon-related-posts/softicon-related-posts.php softicon-related-posts/index.php softicon-related-posts/uninstall.php softicon-related-posts/includes softicon-related-posts/templates softicon-related-posts/assets softicon-related-posts/build softicon-related-posts/languages softicon-related-posts/readme.txt -x '*/.DS_Store' '*.map'
scripts.postzip:
printf '
✔ Zip ready: %s
  %s files, %s

' "$PWD/softicon-related-posts.zip" "$(unzip -l softicon-related-posts.zip | tail -1 | awk '{print $2}')" "$(du -h softicon-related-posts.zip | cut -f1 | tr -d ' ')"
scripts.bundle: npm run lint && npm run zip
